speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The first of the morning was stiff. It has gone off enough to walk, and not enough to boast of.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Uxbridge. The corn is in. You will not be offered the spare for a stiffness you can still walk on.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not asking for it. They are gleaning, and they do not look up.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Gleaning is a living that has no time for a string of horses. Middlesex has had its harvest. You are not in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not in it. I am going on, and the field can keep its own work.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Do not spend Uxbridge on a city you have not come to. Bread is no cheaper for a man who stares at stubble.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we walk. The women can have their field. I have had mine, in another county, and I am not owed a look from this one.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Soft and steady. The last of it is still a long last. If you stiffen again, you say so. You do not gallop the saying.
